name: loom
goal: Run repeated joins, overlapping diamonds, and all required terminal leaves.

specification.goal: Run repeated joins, overlapping diamonds, and all required terminal leaves.

functional_requirements.description: The left source observation is recorded.
The right source observation is recorded.
The E branch observation is recorded.
The F branch observation is recorded.
The G branch observation is recorded.
The K terminal result is recorded.
The L terminal result is recorded.
The independent terminal result is recorded.

nfrs.description: The overlapping analysis joins retain their declared direct evidence.
acceptance: the release follows both H and I receipts, each with its declared suppliers

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('evidence/A.txt'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text('A\n', encoding='utf-8')

done_when: evidence/A.txt contains the shared starting evidence
contract.shared_reason: This setup supplies every branch that participates in the connected braid; the independent M leaf has its own root.

steps.prompt: Read evidence/A.txt. Write only evidence/B.txt with one concise observation. Do not choose a successor or edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted shared evidence is available

steps.prompt: Read evidence/A.txt. Write only evidence/C.txt with a separate concise observation. Do not choose a successor or edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted shared evidence is available

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('evidence/B.txt').is_file() and Path('evidence/C.txt').is_file(); Path('evidence/D.txt').write_text('D\n', encoding='utf-8')

ready_when: the accepted B and C receipts are available
contract.shared_reason: The subsequent analysis branches need both independent source observations.

steps.prompt: Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/E.txt. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted combined source evidence is available
done_when: evidence/E.txt contains the E branch observation

steps.prompt: Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/F.txt. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted combined source evidence is available
done_when: evidence/F.txt contains the F branch observation

steps.prompt: Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/G.txt. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted combined source evidence is available
done_when: evidence/G.txt contains the G branch observation

steps.prompt: Read accepted E and F evidence. Write only evidence/H.txt. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted E and F receipts are available
done_when: evidence/H.txt records the first overlapping join
contract.shared_reason: H is the first explicit overlap between the E and F deliverables.

steps.prompt: Read accepted F and G evidence. Write only evidence/I.txt. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted F and G receipts are available
done_when: evidence/I.txt records the second overlapping join
contract.shared_reason: I is the second explicit overlap, sharing F without inventing an extra edge.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('evidence/H.txt').is_file() and Path('evidence/I.txt').is_file(); Path('evidence/J.txt').write_text('J\n', encoding='utf-8')

ready_when: both accepted overlapping-join receipts are available
done_when: evidence/J.txt records the released combined analysis
contract.shared_reason: The release waits for both overlapping joins and verifies the scope-wide join constraint.

steps.prompt: Read evidence/J.txt. Write only evidence/K.txt as a terminal result. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted released analysis is available
done_when: evidence/K.txt records the first terminal result

steps.prompt: Read evidence/J.txt. Write only evidence/L.txt as an independent terminal result. Do not edit another path.

ready_when: the accepted released analysis is available
done_when: evidence/L.txt records the second terminal result

steps.prompt: Write only evidence/M.txt as an independent terminal note. Do not select another step or edit another path.

done_when: evidence/M.txt records the independent terminal note
